document.abstract: The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) continues its efforts to bring support for rich audio-visual experiences to the web platform. The increase in performance and breadth of the web platform makes it increasingly relevant to professional media workflows, many of which happen to also be migrating to the cloud. Below are recent highlights.

authors.bio: Pierre-Anthony Lemieux is a partner at Sandflow Consulting, San Francisco, CA, where he works with both Holly-wood and Silicon Valley clients on worldwide standards, proof-of-concept development, and product architecture. His expertise covers the entertainment technology ecosystem, from content authoring to playback, including audio and video and timed text, file formats, and content protection.
